name: Itsuki Shishi Hime no Mikoto
source:
Itsuki is a divine being who was roused from her lengthy slumber by Haruki's shenanigans. Unlike Unohana, the land-governing deity, Itsuki's role is to maintain order by cleansing "impurities" as the "Goddess of Purification".

This laid-back goddess has an optimistic outlook and tends to shy away from hassles, but she's no slouch when it comes to fulfilling her sacred duties. Oh, and she's got a bit of a masochistic streak, though she'll be quick to correct you that she's not just an M, but a super-M!

Itsuki's a gamer at heart, but her taste in games is a bit... retro. When she starts living among humans, she frets over whether Pyuuta (an early console from 1982) is sold out and gets her gaming fix with the Virtual Boy (from 1995). Talk about being behind the times!

[Translated and edited from Wikipedia]
